notes: PROFIBUS characterization centers on the RS-485 differential signaling and termination at each baud rate (and the MBP current signaling / intrinsic-safety budget for PA), the 11-bit character with even parity, the MAC timers (TSL/TSDR/TTR), and the 8-bit FCS. Conformance is established by PI (PROFIBUS & PROFINET International) certification testing.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: RS-485 signal levels / eye per baud
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify the differential A/B levels and timing at each baud rate up to 12 Mbit/s.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Bus termination
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm the 220 ohm active termination (390 ohm pull-up/pull-down) at both segment ends.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Character timing / parity
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Validate the 11-bit UART character with even parity at the selected baud.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: MAC timers
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Measure slot time (TSL), TSDR, idle times and Target Rotation Time (TTR).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: PA MBP signaling
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Measure the Manchester current modulation (+-9 mA), DC supply and intrinsic-safety power budget at 31.25 kbit/s.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: FCS coverage
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Inject telegram errors and confirm the 8-bit FCS detects them.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Segment length / station count
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify reach vs baud and up to 32 stations per segment.
